events.title: Junk section purge removes 500,000+ posts; Factor8 loses 26,000
events.description: The junked section was purged, removing over 500,000 posts and dropping nearly all active members' post counts; staff member Factor8 lost a total of 26,000 posts.

events.title: New 'pmme' MyCode added; 'Post here, PM me' threads to be banned
events.description: Omniscient added a new 'pmme' MyCode after suggestions to ban 'Post here, PM me' giveaway threads; he indicated such threads will be disallowed in the future.

events.title: Proxy selling on behalf of other members now banned
events.description: Selling by proxy on behalf of other members is now disallowed; offenders will be repfucked and barred from posting in the Marketplace.

events.title: Reverence leaders wipe membership and plan December re-invitations
events.description: Reverence leaders Astonish is NJ and McFlurry decided to remove every member of the group and start over, with re-invitations planned for December 12, 2011. Many members are angry given that some had paid to enter.

events.title: 32,700 inactive regular accounts closed in past week
events.description: Omniscient announced via Twitter that 32,700 regular accounts inactive for over 6 months were closed in the past week.

events.title: S70N3R was repfucked after he reported all of his green reputations as reputation abuse.
Yellow Skull repfucked by Omniscient for fake scam report
events.description: Yellow Skull was repfucked for posting a fake scam report; Omniscient himself -10'd him with the comment that members shouldn't deal with this user.

events.title: Genuine was repfucked for unknown reasons.
Hot Chocolate was repfucked and banned for 'LQP and Member Harassing.'
Dre Beats™ (formerly SeaNanners) was banned for multiple accounts.
Orgy was banned for constant sales-thread trashing.
Zyzz repfucked and banned by Judge Dredd; later unbanned and limited
events.description: Zyzz was repfucked and banned by Judge Dredd for being a site nuisance; he was later unbanned and is now limited.

events.title: Kiss♥ repfucked and permanently closed after scam reports
events.description: Kiss♥'s account was repfucked and permanently closed; speculation points to the mass scam reports opened against him.

events.title: Graphics Thread: Lat's 'Light' Signature Tutorial in Photoshop.
Hacked Thread: World News writer TheHackersLove posts compromise
events.description: Hacked Thread: TheHackersLove (the World News writer) was hacked and posted about it; he has since regained access.

events.title: Informative Thread: Prince of Persia recaps MythBusters cannonball mishap
events.description: Informative Thread: Prince of Persia's report and video on a MythBusters cannonball experiment that went wrong, hitting houses and a car in Dublin.

events.title: Helpful Thread: Glassy's guide on Partnerships, Hiring, and Personnel.
Eye-Opening: Michael Westen accuses Genuine of taking others' credit
events.description: Eye-Opening Thread: Michael Westen's 'Genuine takes credit for other's work!' — believed to be what led to Genuine's repfuck and the removal of his thread.

events.title: Group leadership changes.
events.description: Existence was demoted from leader of The RATs Crew (cited as 'taking bribes'); kindavidd was promoted to leader of Minecrafters; Diabolic was demoted from leader of Reverence.

events.title: Awards: Tsgh Mike Cat Lover; Diabolic Master Donator and Businessman
events.description: Tsgh Mike received the Cat Lover award (a birthday gift from alabama). Diabolic received the Master Donator and Businessman awards.

events.title: Interview with Glassy conducted by Michael Westen.
events.description: Interview with Glassy conducted by Michael Westen; covers Red Lions and Writ3rs membership, awards philosophy, and his guide-writing motivation.

events.title: Interview with Ignite. conducted by Daniel Faraday.
events.description: Interview with Ignite. conducted by Daniel Faraday; covers his short time on HF, RAT award, and goal to become a Mentor.
